My research examines the political economy of conflict, migration, and climate change, with a geographic focus on the Global South. My agenda spans four major threads, each described on its own page:

- [**Book Project — *The Fortification Dilemma***](research-book-project.qmd)
- [**Conflict**](research-conflict.qmd)
- [**Migration & Forced Displacement**](research-migration.qmd)
- [**Public Opinion & Foreign Policy**](research-public-opinion.qmd)

A full list of my peer-reviewed articles is on my [**Publications**](publications.qmd) page. You can also find my work on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=5VQ8Uw0AAAAJ&hl=en), [Harvard Dataverse](https://dataverse.harvard.edu/dataverse/cwblair), and [SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=3093312). My working papers under review and works in progress are listed below.
